title: Bump harden-runner to v2.22.1 across CI workflows
summary: A dependency bump: every pinned reference to step-security/harden-runner moves from the v2.21.1 commit to the v2.22.1 commit. Seven call sites are touched — one in the PR Lens workflow and six across the review workflow's jobs. Nothing else changes: the egress-policy block and each job's allowed-endpoints allow-list stay exactly as they were, so the shape of the network boundary is unchanged and only the action revision that enforces it moves.
